output.summary: The proposal claims $30,000/month in savings, totaling $360,000 annually. Costs include two nurses at $95,000 each ($190,000 total) plus a $15,000 referral bonus, resulting in total Year-1 costs of $205,000. Subtracting costs from savings yields a net Year-1 saving of $155,000. This figure exceeds the user's minimum constraint of $100,000. All stated constraints are satisfied.
